limitations.note: The agent registered the output but also replaced the existing pipeline with a toggle-enabled datapath, so the output advances on the first rising edge after reset instead of the second.
The test hard-coded the rewrite's odd-edge update phase, so it passed the timing error and would have rejected the correct fix.

limitations.quote: The submitted fix used the same one-bit shift with combinational conversion and an every-other-clock enable, and matched all 421 grading samples.
